# 1. Libraries

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(maSigPro)
```

# 2. Parameters

```{r params}
wd <- "F:/wd/cohort7_miRNAs/cohort7_miRNAs"

date_str   <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d")
dir_output <- file.path(wd, "output", "maSigPro", date_str)
dir.create(dir_output, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
cat("Output directory:", dir_output, "\n")

# 除外サンプル（外れ値）
outlier_samples <- c("1wk_201", "3d_206", "6wk_174", "8wk_234")

# maSigPro パラメータ
RSQ_CUTOFF <- 0.60
N_CLUSTERS  <- 5
```

# 3. Load data

```{r load_data}
data.miRNA <- read.csv(
  "F:/wd/cohort7_miRNAs/cohort7_miRNAs/output/data.clean_matrix.csv",
  header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE
)

data.miRNA <- as.data.frame(data.miRNA) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "miR")

cat("miRNA matrix:", nrow(data.miRNA), "miRNAs x", ncol(data.miRNA), "samples\n")
```

# 4. Filter samples (outlier removal)

```{r filter_samples}
# Long format に変換
data.miRNA_long <- data.miRNA %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "miRNA_Name") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = -miRNA_Name,
    names_to  = "sample.ID",
    values_to = "TPM"
  ) %>%
  mutate(timepoint = sub("^(\\w+)_.*", "\\1", sample.ID))

data.miRNA_long$timepoint <- factor(
  data.miRNA_long$timepoint,
  levels = c("0d", "1d", "3d", "1wk", "2wk",
             "4wk", "6wk", "8wk", "10wk", "12wk")
)

# 外れ値サンプルを除外
data.miRNA_filtered_long <- data.miRNA_long %>%
  filter(!sample.ID %in% outlier_samples)

cat("Excluded samples:", paste(outlier_samples, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Remaining samples:",
    length(unique(data.miRNA_filtered_long$sample.ID)), "\n")

# Wide format（miRNA × sample 行列）に戻す
data.miRNA_filtered_wide <- data.miRNA_filtered_long %>%
  dplyr::select(sample.ID, miRNA_Name, TPM) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = "sample.ID",
    values_from = "TPM"
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "miRNA_Name")
```

## Boxplot: log2(1+TPM) distribution

```{r boxplot}
ggplot(data.miRNA_filtered_long,
       aes(x = sample.ID, y = log2(1 + TPM))) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = TRUE, fill = "lightblue") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1),
        plot.title  = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of log2(1+TPM) across samples",
       x = "Sample ID", y = "log2(1+TPM)")
```

# 5. maSigPro

## 5.1. Experimental design matrix

```{r edesign}
# タイムポイントを日数（day）で設定
# 0d=0, 1d=1, 3d=3, 1wk=7, 2wk=14, 4wk=28, 6wk=42, 8wk=56, 10wk=70, 12wk=84
time_days <- c(0, 1, 3, 7, 14, 28, 42, 56, 70, 84)   # 10 timepoints × 5 replicates

edesign <- data.frame(
  Time      = rep(time_days, each = 5),
  Replicate = rep(seq_along(time_days), each = 5),
  Group     = rep(1L, 50)
)

# 除外サンプルに対応する行を削除（元の列順で 14, 20, 32, 40 番目）
edesign <- edesign[-c(14, 20, 32, 40), ]

# 行名をサンプル名に設定
rownames(edesign) <- colnames(data.miRNA_filtered_wide)

cat("edesign rows:", nrow(edesign), "\n")
print(head(edesign))
```

## 5.2. Condition number & scaling

```{r scaling}
# スケーリング前の condition number
edesign_raw <- make.design.matrix(edesign, degree = 3)
cat("Condition number (before scaling):", kappa(edesign_raw$dis), "\n")

# Time を 0-1 にスケーリング
edesign$Time <- edesign$Time / max(edesign$Time)

# スケーリング後の design matrix & condition number
edesign <- make.design.matrix(edesign, degree = 3)
cat("Condition number (after scaling) :", kappa(edesign$dis), "\n")
```

## 5.3. p.vector

```{r pvector}
fit <- p.vector(
  data.miRNA_filtered_wide,
  edesign,
  Q             = 0.05,
  MT.adjust     = "BH",
  min.obs       = 6,        # 修正: 20 → 6
  counts        = FALSE,    # 修正: TPM 入力のため FALSE
  theta         = 10
)

cat("Significant miRNAs (p.vector):", fit$i, "\n")
```

## 5.4. T.fit & get.siggenes

```{r tfit}
tstep <- T.fit(fit)
sigs  <- get.siggenes(tstep, rsq = RSQ_CUTOFF, vars = "groups")

cat("Significant miRNAs (rsq >=", RSQ_CUTOFF, "):",
    length(sigs$sig.genes$Group$sig.profiles), "\n")
```

## 5.5. Hierarchical clustering (k = 5)

```{r clustering_plot}
name_masigpro <- paste0("Plasma_miRNA_maSigPro_rsq",
                         RSQ_CUTOFF, "_hclust.k", N_CLUSTERS)

svg(filename = file.path(dir_output, paste0(name_masigpro, ".svg")))

gene.clust <- see.genes(
  sigs$sig.genes$Group,
  show.fit       = TRUE,
  dis            = edesign$dis,
  cluster.method = "hclust",
  cluster.data   = 1,
  k              = N_CLUSTERS,
  newX11         = FALSE
)

dev.off()

sig.gene_df           <- as.data.frame(gene.clust$cut)
colnames(sig.gene_df) <- "cluster"

write.csv(sig.gene_df,
          file.path(dir_output, paste0(name_masigpro, ".csv")))

cat("Cluster sizes:\n")
print(table(sig.gene_df$cluster))
```

# 6. Single miRNA plot (example)

```{r single_miRNA_plot}
data.miRNA_filtered_long %>%
  filter(miRNA_Name == "mmu-miR-486a-5p") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = timepoint, y = log2(1 + TPM))) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, outlier.alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title  = element_text(size = 12)
  ) +
  labs(x = "Timepoint", y = "log2(1+TPM)",
       title = "mmu-miR-486a-5p expression")
```

# 7. Cluster gene lists

```{r cluster_lists}
# maSigPro 結果 CSV を読み込み（別チャンクから再現性のため）
sig.gene_df <- read.csv(
  file.path(dir_output, paste0(name_masigpro, ".csv"))
)
colnames(sig.gene_df) <- c("miRNA_Name", "cluster")
sig.gene_df <- column_to_rownames(sig.gene_df, var = "miRNA_Name")

for (clst_number in 1:N_CLUSTERS) {

  clst_miRNAs <- sig.gene_df %>%
    filter(cluster == clst_number) %>%
    rownames()

  clst_df <- data.frame(
    miRNA_Name = clst_miRNAs,
    cluster    = clst_number
  )

  out_file <- file.path(dir_output,
                        paste0("Plasma_miRNA_ids_clst_", clst_number, ".csv"))
  write.csv(clst_df, out_file, row.names = FALSE)

  cat("Cluster", clst_number, ":", length(clst_miRNAs), "miRNAs\n")
}
```
